cases.scenario: Initial load of the application after sign-in (one user, empty cache)
cases.tool: Playwright (Chromium, cache disabled), built bundle served by the backend
cases.target: ≤ 3 s to the meeting list being usable
cases.condition: Internal network ≥ 10 Mbps; measure 5 times, record the slowest
cases.note: Local workstation (app, database and browser on one machine), built bundle served by a second instance of the same build. Load with many users is TC-PERF-004. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-190841 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8
cases.actual: 0.74 s slowest of 5 (740, 488, 462, 526, 530 ms; built bundle, cache disabled)

cases.scenario: Upload a 10 MB PDF to a meeting and open its preview
cases.target: Listed ≤ 5 s after transfer; preview opens ≤ 3 s
cases.condition: One upload at a time; transfer time excluded
cases.actual: 10.0 MB PDF: stored in 3.38 s including the local transfer, listed 0.10 s after the answer; preview 2.08 s
cases.note: Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: Approver receives the in-app notification after the Organizer submits a meeting
cases.tool: Playwright (two browsers, bell count polled every 100 ms)
cases.target: ≤ 10 s from "Gửi duyệt" to the bell count changing
cases.condition: Approver's browser already open and connected
cases.note: Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070906-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: System stays responsive with many users browsing at once
cases.tool: Node.js load script (100 virtual users, Playwright request contexts)
cases.target: 100 concurrent users, error rate < 1%, 95% of API requests ≤ 1 s
cases.condition: Single-server Docker deployment as on the test server
cases.actual: 100 virtual users, 60 s, 9,134 requests: error rate 0.00%, p95 173 ms, p50 148 ms, max 581 ms
cases.note: Condition not met: one Windows workstation ran the app, PostgreSQL, Redis and the load generator, not the single-server Docker deployment; reads only (meeting list, notifications, meeting details, /auth/me), each user every 0.5 s. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: Ordinary reads and a create-meeting submission by one user
cases.tool: Node.js script (100 reads of 5 endpoints, 10 meeting creations)
cases.target: 95% of API requests ≤ 1 s; no form submission > 3 s
cases.condition: Excluding file transfer and AI processing
cases.actual: reads p95 30 ms (max 34 ms); create meeting p95 36 ms (max 36 ms)
cases.note: Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: First page of the meeting (with search), user, notification, audit-log and document lists
cases.target: First page ≤ 2 s for 95% of requests
cases.condition: Data volume up to 10,000 meetings, 50,000 documents, 1,000,000 audit entries
cases.actual: p95: meetings 6 ms, users 11 ms, notifications 10 ms, audit log 67 ms, documents 24 ms
cases.note: Condition not met: the local database held 218 meetings, 21 documents and about 2,650 audit entries, far below the stated volume. Re-measure on seeded data before acceptance. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.requirement: Meeting audio upload and AI processing
cases.scenario: A 10-minute WAV upload is acknowledged and queued
cases.target: Acknowledged and queued ≤ 5 s after transfer
cases.actual: 18.3 MB (10 min WAV) acknowledged in 0.12 s, HTTP 201 MSG290, transcription Pending
cases.note: Transfer is local, so the time is mostly the server acknowledging and queuing. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: Time to join the online room ("Vào phòng" → in the room) for three people
cases.tool: Playwright with fake camera and microphone, local LiveKit
cases.condition: Participants on a stable connection; self-hosted media server
cases.note: Joining only; capacity of 30, audio delay and 3 rooms at once are TC-PERF-009. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184514 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8

cases.scenario: 30 participants with audio and video plus a screen share; 3 rooms at once; audio delay
cases.note: Needs a rehearsal with 30 real devices and a way to measure mouth-to-ear delay; not done in Round 1.

cases.scenario: Open "Báo cáo" and export 12 months to Excel
cases.actual: screen ready 1.57 s; 12-month report API 0.03 s; Excel export 0.03 s (3,079 bytes)
cases.note: Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-185048 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8
